data.title: Add Paused status for bugs
data.body:
## Goal

Add a `Paused` status for bugs that are intentionally set aside.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Add `Paused` variant to `Status` enum
- [ ] `docket pause ID` transitions InProgress → Paused
- [ ] `docket resume ID` transitions Paused → InProgress
- [ ] Paused bugs are hidden from default `docket list` (like Done)
- [ ] `docket list --paused` or `--all` shows paused bugs
- [ ] Optionally store a reason: `docket pause ID --reason "switching to higher priority"`

## Context

Different from Blocked: Paused is an intentional choice to set work aside, Blocked is waiting on external factors. Paused bugs aren't actively being worked on but aren't abandoned either.

## Log

- 2026-01-15: Implemented Paused status with all acceptance criteria met:
  - Added `Paused` variant to `Status` enum in bug.rs with display, parsing, sort order
  - Added `paused_reason` field to `BugMetadata` and accessor to `Bug`
  - Added `Paused` and `Resumed` event types in event.rs
  - Created `pause` command (InProgress → Paused) with optional `--reason` flag
  - Created `resume` command (Paused → InProgress)
  - Updated `list` command to hide paused bugs by default and added `--paused` flag
  - Updated `show`, `sync`, `work`, and `log` commands to handle Paused status
  - All tests pass (56 unit tests, 32 integration tests)
  - Clippy passes with -D warnings
